statements.attributed: HEAs show excellent mechanical properties in high- or cryogenic-temperature environments
statements.quote: In the high- or cryogenic-temperature environment, HEAs show excellent mechanical properties as well , which brings great HEA manufacturing potential in terms of structural components in various industrial sectors .

statements.attributed: found that the yield strength, the ultimate strength and the fracture elongation of as-casted Al and C-Containing CoCrFeNiMn-type HEAs are 210 MPa, 455 MPa and 80%, respectively, and after rolling with the reduction of 80%, the yield strength and the ultimate strength increase to 1310 MPa and 1500 Mpa, respectively, while the fracture elongation decreases to 6.5%
statements.quote: Klimova et al. found that the yield strength, the ultimate strength and the fracture elongation of as-casted Al and C-Containing CoCrFeNiMn-type HEAs are 210 MPa, 455 MPa and 80%, respectively, and after rolling with the reduction of 80%, the yield strength and the ultimate strength increase to 1310 MPa and 1500 Mpa, respectively, while the fracture elongation decreases to 6.5%.

statements.attributed: found that the ultimate tensile strength of the as-homogenized FeCrCuMnNi HEA is approximately 500 MPa, and when it is cold-rolled with the deformation of 85%, the ultimate strength increases by approximately 160%
statements.quote: Shabani et al. found that the ultimate tensile strength of the as-homogenized FeCrCuMnNi HEA is approximately 500 MPa, and when it is cold-rolled with the deformation of 85%, the ultimate strength increases by approximately 160%.

statements.attributed: found that after cold-rolling and post-deformation annealing, for the casted CrMnFeCoNi, which is homogenized and quenched, the yield strength increases from 209 MPa to 352 MPa and the ultimate tensile strength increases from 566 MPa to 702 MPa, while the elongation decreases from 59.3% to 43.8%
statements.quote: Zou et al. found that after cold-rolling and post-deformation annealing, for the casted CrMnFeCoNi, which is homogenized and quenched, the yield strength increases from 209 MPa to 352 MPa and the ultimate tensile strength increases from 566 MPa to 702 MPa, while the elongation decreases from 59.3% to 43.8%.

statements.attributed: found that the yield strength increased from 161 MPa to 1259 MPa and 1082 MPa for cryorolled and cold-rolled as-casted CoCrFeNiMn HEA, respectively, and after annealing at 873 K, both the yield strength and the ultimate tensile strength of the cryorolled HEA were greater than those of the cold-rolled HEAs
statements.quote: Wu et al. respectively cryorolled and cold-rolled as-casted CoCrFeNiMn HEA to prepare sheets and found that the yield strength increased from 161 MPa to 1259 MPa and 1082 MPa, respectively, and after annealing at 873 K, both the yield strength and the ultimate tensile strength of the cryorolled HEA were greater than those of the cold-rolled HEAs.

statements.attributed: found that when the engineering strain rate is 10−3/s, the tensile ductility of both CrMnFeCoNi and CrFeCoNi decreases from higher than 60% to lower than 35% as the temperature increases from 77 K to 1273 K
statements.quote: Gali et al. found that when the engineering strain rate is 10−3/s, the tensile ductility of both CrMnFeCoNi and CrFeCoNi decreases from higher than 60% to lower than 35% as the temperature increases from 77 K to 1273 K.

statements.attributed: found that the strength of the CoCrFeMnNi HEA has strong temperature dependence when the temperature is in the range from 77 K to 1073 K, and when the temperature is 77 K, the 0.2% offset yield strength, the ultimate tensile strength and the fracture elongation all reach the maximum
statements.quote: Otto et al. found that the strength of the CoCrFeMnNi HEA has strong temperature dependence when the temperature is in the range from 77 K to 1073 K, and when the temperature is 77 K, the 0.2% offset yield strength, the ultimate tensile strength and the fracture elongation all reach the maximum.

statements.attributed: found that when the temperature decreases from 300 K to 4.2 K, the nominal yield strength of the Ag0.5 CoCrCuFeNi HEA increases from 450 MPa to 750 MPa
statements.quote: Laktinova et al. found that when the temperature decreases from 300 K to 4.2 K, the nominal yield strength of the Ag0.5 CoCrCuFeNi HEA increases from 450 MPa to 750 MPa.

statements.attributed: found that as the temperature decreases from 293 K to 77 K, the yield strength, the ultimate tensile strength and the tensile ductility of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA increase approximately 85%, approximately 70% and approximately 25%, respectively, and when the temperature is 77 K, the yield strength and the ultimate tensile strength of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA are 759 MPa and 1280 MPa, respectively
statements.quote: Gludovatz et al. found that as the temperature decreases from 293 K to 77 K, the yield strength, the ultimate tensile strength and the tensile ductility of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA increase approximately 85%, approximately 70% and approximately 25%, respectively, and when the temperature is 77 K, the yield strength and the ultimate tensile strength of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA are 759 MPa and 1280 MPa, respectively.

statements.attributed: found that as the temperature decreases from 293 K to 77 K, the engineering yield strength of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA increases from 265 ± 10 MPa to 460 ± 30 MPa, the ultimate tensile strength increases from 600 ± 40 MPa to 1060 ± 70 MPa, and the tensile ductility increases by approximately 50% as well
statements.quote: Laplanche et al. found that as the temperature decreases from 293 K to 77 K, the engineering yield strength of the CrMnFeCoNi HEA increases from 265 ± 10 MPa to 460 ± 30 MPa, the ultimate tensile strength increases from 600 ± 40 MPa to 1060 ± 70 MPa, and the tensile ductility increases by approximately 50% as well.

statements.attributed: found that as the temperature decreases from RT to 77 K, the mechanism of the plastic deformation of the HEA changes from dislocation gliding to the mix of dislocation gliding and nanoscale twinning
statements.quote: As the temperature decreases from RT to 77 K, the mechanism of the plastic deformation of the HEA changes from dislocation gliding to the mix of dislocation gliding and nanoscale twinning .

statements.attributed: found that the appearance of nanoscale twinning may postpone the onset of necking
statements.quote: The appearance of nanoscale twinning may postpone the onset of necking , which may be the reason for the increase in both the strength and the ductility as the temperature decreases from −160 °C to −196 °C.

statements.attributed: found that the appearance of nanoscale twinning may postpone the onset of necking
statements.quote: The appearance of nanoscale twinning may postpone the onset of necking , which may be the reason for the increase in both the strength and the ductility as the temperature decreases from −160 °C to −196 °C.

statements.attributed: found that nanoscale twinning is difficult to be observed with EBSD
statements.quote: It may be obtained that as the temperature decreases from RT to −196 °C, the effect of the dislocation motion of the biaxial deformation is not weakened, while the effect of the nanoscale twinning, which is difficult to be observed with EBSD , may be enhanced and may be the cause of the improvement in the plasticity of the CoCrFeMnNi HEA at cryogenic temperatures.
